scope: deterministic exact periodic Voronoi auxiliary geometry, one preregistered smooth shear state
number_model: Fraction of unchanged float64 inputs; exact halfplanes and vertices
density_model: given point density on its unweighted nearest-point auxiliary cell
bin_count: max(2,ceil(sqrt(ceil(point_count/4)))) per axis; exact coordinate-to-bin assignment
provisional_constraints: 8 nearest available candidates from deterministic expanding neighboring bins; only to shrink a superset
complete_search: for provisional polygon P, R=max vertex L1 distance from seed; enumerate every image bin intersecting seed+[-2R,2R]^2
safe_rejection: image displacement squared greater than 4R^2 cannot cut P; all tests exact
clipping: 2*v dot p <= v dot v, exact intersections, preserve CCW and incoming face labels
zero_dimensional_contacts: not positive faces; remove only exactly coincident representation vertices, never small positive faces
cell_support: distinct positive-area cells with no active self-image faces; unsupported sparse configurations stop explicitly
face_ratio: cross(seed displacement, CCW edge vector)/squared seed distance, exact positive rational |face|/distance
sharing: canonical identity/image key, exact counterpart endpoint and ratio equality; no averaging
area_control: exact local polygon/pyramid identities; directed dyadic enclosure of all raw cell areas must contain the exact periodic area
no_global_fraction_lcm: global sums of unrelated fractions use rigorous dyadic enclosures; no input or area normalization
independent_geometry_probe: for each fixed ID, check every other original point's exact nearest-image halfplane; final radius < min(periods)/4 required for this independent check
action_control_formula: 64*epsilon*(max_degree+1)*max(1,sqrt(total actual mass))*max(1,max row L1)*max(1,max abs c0)
